verdict.rationale: DPMA is a patent and trade mark office with online search and e-filing services, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The evidence describes only human-facing portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb/Pro) and shows no llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. The probe found only a robots.txt that disallows crawling on the register host, which is the opposite of agent-friendly access.
